integrity: The all-size statement is proved by forbidden-induced-subgraph structure, run enumeration, and a component product. Independent finite brute force using the original forbidden graphs checks representative cases; no external certification claimed.
limitations: Finite nonempty simple graphs of maximum degree at most two; enumeration uses exactly two named colors, possibly unused; no arbitrary k-color enumerator or graphs of higher degree. Historical priority and independent validation remain open.
title: Threshold-partition enumerators and the odd-cycle obstruction at maximum degree two
